Exclusion criteria in the [[akut-kirurgi-databasen|Akut Kirurgi Databasen]] are systematically applied to filter patient data before calculating clinical quality indicators. These criteria ensure that only relevant and accurately documented cases are included in the final assessments for metrics such as [[indikator-1|Indikator 1]] and [[indikator-10|Indikator 10]]. 

A significant portion of exclusions is driven by basic demographic and administrative filters. For instance, patients are routinely excluded if they have an invalid [[cpr-nummer|CPR-nummer]], are under 18 years of age, or are registered as inactive in the civil registration system [^src1]. When calculating Indikator 1, the database excluded 53 patients due to an invalid CPR number, 170 patients for being under 18, and 6,190 patients because they were not operated on [^src4]. Additionally, 200 patients were excluded from Indikator 1 because preoperative antibiotic prophylaxis was not administered, and 470 were excluded because the procedure was not their first operation during the hospital stay [^src4]. 

Clinical comorbidity is another major factor in the exclusion process. The [[charlson-comorbiditets-indeks|Charlson Comorbiditets indeks]] is used to filter out patients whose comorbidity scores fall outside the target range. Specifically, patients with a score of 0 or greater than 2 are excluded from certain analyses; this criterion alone removed 2,395 patients in one calculation [^src2] and 2,468 patients in another [^src5]. Overall, the database tracks these exclusions meticulously, recording thousands of omitted cases—such as 6,186 patients who were not operated on and 473 whose surgery was not the first in their admission—to maintain the statistical integrity of its quality indicators [^src3].

## Claims

- Eksklusion: 53 Ugyldigt CPRnummer. 173 Patienten er under 18 år. 6.178 Patienten er ikke opereret. 5 Patienten er registreret i CPR-registeret som 'Inaktiv, uden bopæl i dansk/grønlandsk folkeregister men tildelt personnummer af skattehensyn (kommunekoderne 0010, 0011, 0012 og 0019)'. 474 Operationen er ikke den første operation i hospitalsopholdet. [^src1] (indikator-10)
- Eksklusion: 53 Ugyldigt CPRnummer. 172 Patienten er under 18 år. 6.186 Patienten er ikke opereret. 5 Patienten er registreret i CPR-registeret som 'Inaktiv, uden bopæl i dansk/grønlandsk folkeregister men tildelt personnummer af skattehensyn (kommunekoderne 0010, 0011, 0012 og 0019)'. 473 Operationen er ikke den første operation i hospitalsopholdet. 2.395 Patientens Charlson Comorbiditets indeks = 0 eller > 2 [^src1] (cpr-nummer, charlson-comorbiditets-indeks)
- Antal ekskluderede patienter: 53 med ugyldigt CPR-nummer, 172 under 18 år, 6.186 ikke opereret, 473 med ikke-første operation i hospitalsopholdet [^src1] (akut-kirurgi-databasen)
- Der blev ekskluderet 53 patienter pga. ugyldigt CPR-nummer i forbindelse med beregningen af Indikator 1 [^src1] (indikator-1)
- Der blev ekskluderet 170 patienter fordi de er under 18 år i forbindelse med beregningen af Indikator 1 [^src1] (indikator-1)
- Der blev ekskluderet 6.190 patienter fordi de ikke er opereret i forbindelse med beregningen af Indikator 1 [^src1] (indikator-1)
- Der blev ekskluderet 200 patienter fordi præoperativ antibiotikaprofylakse ikke er givet i forbindelse med beregningen af Indikator 1 [^src1] (indikator-1)
- Der blev ekskluderet 470 patienter fordi operationen ikke er den første i hospitalsopholdet i forbindelse med beregningen af Indikator 1 [^src1] (indikator-1)
- I alt blev der ekskluderet 2.468 patienter på grund af Charlson Comorbiditets indeks = 0 eller > 2 [^src1] (charlson-comorbiditets-indeks)
